---
# The always-open companion to wk03-exercises.qmd.
#
# Same page, same content, solutions never gated -- for Carlisle and the TA.
# The week file is the only source; this wrapper adds nothing but front matter.
# To make one of these for a new week, copy this file and change the two
# `wk03` strings below.
#
# `solution-unlock` in the past is what opens the solutions: the week file
# does not set that key, so this one survives the include's metadata merge.
# (`title` does not survive -- the week file's wins -- hence the subtitle.)
subtitle: "Instructor and TA copy: complete solutions, always open"
solution-unlock: "2000-01-01 00:00"

# Keep it off the site's search box and out of Google.
search: false
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      text: '<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">'
---

{{< include wk03-exercises.qmd >}}
